notes: The 2024 GPX contains named waypoints for parking, spring, barracks, tower and summit area.
GPX device elevation is reference evidence; catalog elevations use Open-Meteo GLO-90 DEM with route-source cross-check.
The legacy GPX has synthetic 40-second timestamps and is used for geometry cross-check only, not timing.

farakhsineh_to_darabad.title: فراخ‌سینه تا قلهٔ دارآباد
farakhsineh_to_darabad.subtitle: از درهٔ دارآباد و چشمهٔ خلیل تا خط‌الرأس و قله

notes: The 2019 GPX follows the Chalmags, Haft Hoz, Darazlash and Khalil branch before reaching the summit ridge.
This is a longer alternate route; its geometry includes route bends and should not be treated as a technical ridge traverse.
The legacy GPX has synthetic 40-second timestamps and is used for geometry cross-check only, not timing.

hajiabad_to_darabad.title: حاجی‌آباد تا قلهٔ دارآباد
hajiabad_to_darabad.subtitle: از مسیر شمالی حاجی‌آباد تا قلهٔ دارآباد

notes: The 2023 GPX reaches the summit area and is the primary Hajiabad geometry source.
The middle point is a route-specific representative point on the northern ridge because the public GPX has no named intermediate waypoint.
The 2020 GPX is used as an independent ascent and summit cross-check; its post-summit descent is excluded from one-way timing.
